input.summary: Insert Contractor indemnity (IP infringement, breach of law, Confidential Information breach, gross negligence/wilful misconduct) as new Section 7(d), carved out of the liability cap.
input.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement contains no indemnity from Contractor, so we added a Section 7(d) requiring Contractor to defend and indemnify us against third-party IP infringement claims and claims arising from its breach of law, mishandling of our Confidential Information, or gross negligence or wilful misconduct, with standard notice, control and cooperation mechanics. Our playbook requires a Vendor IP and misconduct indemnity that is not swallowed by the fee-based cap; if needed, we can discuss customary IP exclusions (our modifications, combinations or specifications) and a super-cap of 3x annual fees on these obligations.

ops.text: (d) INDEMNIFICATION BY CONTRACTOR. Contractor shall defend, indemnify and hold harmless Company and its affiliates from and against any third-party claim, and all resulting damages, costs and expenses (including reasonable attorneys' fees), to the extent arising out of (i) an allegation that the Services or Works infringe or misappropriate any intellectual property right; (ii) Contractor's breach of applicable law; (iii) any unauthorized access to or disclosure of Company's Confidential Information caused by Contractor; or (iv) Contractor's gross negligence or wilful misconduct. Company shall give Contractor prompt written notice of any such claim, Contractor shall have control of the defense and settlement of the claim (provided that Contractor shall not settle any claim in a manner that imposes any liability or obligation on, or requires any admission by, Company without Company's prior written consent), and Company shall provide reasonable cooperation at Contractor's expense. Contractor's obligations under this Section 7(d) are not subject to the limitations or waivers set forth in Sections 7(a), 7(b) and 7(c).
